crossRefs.note: They said, “If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, don’t send it empty; but by all means return a trespass…
Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not…
When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter…
It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king, except the gods…
Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.
But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.
The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many…
saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly…
But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

translations.web: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
translations.bsb: “This is the finger of God,” the magicians said to Pharaoh. But Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said.
translations.kjv: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
translations.asv: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as Jehovah had spoken.
